title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode7 A Changed World

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: Center Theatre

rows.Speaker: Member of Other Troupe
rows.Line: “Let now this door be opened!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As expected...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The Araumi Troupe, Otome Productions... From household names to those best known by connoisseurs, all sorts are here for the contest.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! That one was really good, too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...! Honestly, I feel like any troupe could win this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Every troupe has performed very well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However... There are a lot of eyes on the next group up. We should expect something even better yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi's team...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What's this? Why is the theatre...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Hmm, I just can't seem to find them!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah! Asahi's in the aisle!

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Is it you? Are you my fated one?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Or perhaps... Is it you, my brawny fellow?!”

rows.Speaker: Member of Other Troupe
rows.Line: M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Hmm, still no luck... I've spent so long searching. Wherever could my princess be?”
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, he's made his entrance perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Right, Asahi's role was a prince searching for his fated princess.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I saw them practicing this next to us, but this is the first time we've seen the whole thing from the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing it.)

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Oh, why is it? I've looked almost everywhere, but I can't find my princess.”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Ah! What if they've been imprisoned by a wicked dragon?! I must rescue them!”

rows.Speaker: Little Bird
rows.Line: “My prince, my prince! Do you even know what your princess is like?”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Of course I do! My princess is someone who will embrace me with deep love!”

rows.Speaker: Little Bird
rows.Line: “Deep love... That's rather vague, isn't it?”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Is my princess truly even out there, do you think?”

rows.Speaker: Old Wolf
rows.Line: “Hmm. What makes you say that, my prince?”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “My old nanny always used to say that someday I'd find someone who would love me deeply, and I've always believed her, but...”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “I may be a prince, but I'm not a very smart or useful prince. Is there really someone out there who could love me, even so?”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Ah... I see. I finally understand.”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “I spent so long looking for someone to love me, when what I needed was to give love to others myself.”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “If I can find someone I want to share my life with...and we can nurture love together...”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “The truth is... Anyone could be my princess.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His emotion is coming through.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can feel the warmth spreading through the prince's chest as though it was my own.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi never disappoints.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He never does. All his castmates were impressive, as well. The script and direction were also clever. I found myself being drawn in.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're not just going to let them have it, are we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't steal my line.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Consider it payback for last time!
Every actor wants to take the best lines for themselves, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Everyone is so motivated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. After all... We're about to put on an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The time has come.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's show everyone how Wonderlands×Showtime has evolved!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's put smiles on all those faces!
Won-won...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (Hmm... Finally, the last one.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (None of these performances have been terrible... But nothing much surprising, either.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (About the only one worth remembering is Asahi Genbu, I suppose. He has the greatest acting range. He alone was enough to elevate the rest of the show.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (He'll likely be the only one I can get any use out of.)
“Big brother, big brother! Tell me that story again!”
“Of course I will. You really love this one, don't you, Emily?”

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (Ah... The last group is Kamishiro's.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (Let's see what they can do this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Finally, here it is...!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (It was already looking pretty solid during our joint practices...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (But the confidence in their eyes... We're going to see something special.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (I just can't wait for this show...!)

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: “Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a brave prince and a gentle princess.”

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: “When the princess was kidnapped by the wicked Dark Lord, the prince overcame many trials...”

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: “And defeated the Dark Lord to rescue her.”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Princess! The Dark Lord lies defeated. I have come to rescue you!”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “Oh, my prince...! My beloved! Take me from this place, and I'll stay by your side, wherever you may go!”

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: “And so the prince and princess were married. And they all lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line: “However, this is where our story begins. What comes after 'happily ever after'?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Now, let's go!)

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
How did it come to this?”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Of course I treasure Harte, but lately every time we meet, we fight. We say such cruel things...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “No... I know why. It's because my work as crown prince has been weighing on me so heavily.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Harte knows how busy I've been, and she wants to help me. And yet, I...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Now, now. I'm sure if we only speak to one another, we can find an understanding.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “When brother clasps hands with brother, kingdom with kingdom, both flourish. The same must surely be true for lovers!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “As soon as I finish my work, I'll go see Harte. We'll talk this all out!”
se_walk_men_002_3

rows.Speaker: Secretary Nidd
rows.Line: “Well... He has stamina, if nothing else.”

rows.Speaker: Secretary Nidd
rows.Line: “What a headache. This kingdom would be in much better hands with his younger brother on the throne.”

rows.Speaker: Secretary Nidd
rows.Line: “I suppose I'll have to...expedite matters.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“Harte, I think we should have a proper talk—
Ugh!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “B-Blesse? What's wrong?”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “W-We...talk...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Alright! That's all our work finished for the day!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Huh? But... You have that meeting with the messenger from the neighboring kingdom to negotiate for peace.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“It's not as though that will actually help relations, right?
I'd rather spend some quality time with you, Harte!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Blesse! People have seen something unusual in the mountains. A spiraling black cloud. The people are uneasy, so let's send someone to...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
Just uneasy? Just leave it be, then. We can't chase after every tiresome thing they panic about.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “As long as we look like we're listening, that will satisfy the masses.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “No matter how hard we work to make them all happy, or rescue people who are suffering, they don't care, and they'll never understand our efforts.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Laws that benefit them personally are popular. Laws that don't get endless complaining. There's no point in working ourselves to the bone for people like that.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Something is wrong...
Yes, Blesse is spending more time with me now. But somehow...”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff...
Princess Harte!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Huh? Wait, you...!
You're the fairy who traveled with Blesse to rescue me?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “Yeah! I can sniff out traces of evil magic, so I joined the prince on his journey!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “Just now, I smelled something really bad coming down from the mountains, so I came here to tell the prince...”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “And the same smell is coming off of him! So I can't say for sure, but I think the prince may be cursed by something deep in the mountains...!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Huh?! Cursed?!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“I see... So that's why...!
Oh, why didn't I see it sooner?!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “No, that's not important. Good Fairy! How do we undo the curse?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “There's only one way.”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “The one who's cursed has to personally destroy the source of the curse. So...”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “The prince has to go into the mountains, find the cursed object and destroy it!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (WXS really is amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (There are only four of them, but the worlds they build feel so fleshed out.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (That must be thanks to Rui's direction, I'm sure.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (And I have to say... Tsukasa's acting has improved quite a bit. I'm really looking forward to what comes next!)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (I wonder how he'll portray the despair at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Phew... We've made it over all those rocks...”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “What a surprise that Nidd person was a bad guy! I put him to sleep, but we'll have to bring him back to the castle when we're done here!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Yeah... Right...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're almost at the pivotal scene.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Don't worry. You've practiced so many times.)

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “We're so close to the cursed flower now! Blesse, just a little further up this path and we'll be at the summit!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“Yeah...
Thanks, Harte...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“Right. Just a little further...
Just a little more, and this curse...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Blesse?!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “Ugh, that stink! The curse is getting stronger and stronger!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“But we're so close to the flower!
Blesse!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Here it is.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Leap into the darkness!!!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The moment I would fully despair would be the moment I lost my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But so long as I never give up on my dream, that would never happen. I would never despair.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But... There is one way.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If it wasn't me, but the world that changed...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If, no matter how I struggled, I remained powerless...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is...the station?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What happened? Why is everything so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...right. I remember now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everything changed...in the blink of an eye.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This world...became ruled by hatred.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Curse them...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: I just want to live a normal life...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Why is everything so hard for me?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: It's their fault. It has to be.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: If they...weren't around anymore...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: “We can just talk this all out”? That's just idealism.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Yeah. The real world doesn't work like that.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line:
It's all their fault I'm suffering like this.
If only they would all just disappear...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Yeah! Then... All our problems will be solved!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That won't make a world where everyone is smiling. Someone will be left suffering as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want a world with a smile on every face! That's why I put on my shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, more than ever, I need to deliver smiles!
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Come one, come all! The curtain rises!
See the hero Pegasus fight to protect everyone's dreams!”

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line:
A show...?
Who's got the time for that?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: I don't have time to waste clapping along to some made-up fairy tale. Just go already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
Then what about this?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Send in the clowns!
Watch as I balance on top of the entire Earth, all to make you smile!”

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Whatever. Can't you find someone who can actually help me?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: We know whose fault this is. We just need to beat them down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! I'm not done yet! I'll keep on trying as many times as I must!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll keep on trying until the world is filled with smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “This is a little tale of hope.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hope that, even in spite of hatred, people can come together in peace. A little—”

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Just stop already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Your stories are pointless.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Having fun and laughing for just a moment...over and over... What's the point of that?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: It won't fill your belly or cure sickness.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: All your grand, sparkling tales of love and hope do...is remind us that we don't have any of that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: And...all your talk about making everyone smile?

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: We need that least of all.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: It's their fault we're suffering. They don't deserve to smile.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: I'm leaving. This whole thing has been a waste of time.

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: You can say that again. Better to find as many of them as we can and...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Stay away. Stay away from me...

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Pointless. All of this is pointless...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey! Wait!!!
Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please, wait!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It really is hopeless after all, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How cruel and ugly reality is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who could have thought that humans could hate each other so much?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A show that transcends borders was just a pipe dream.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In the end, shows are powerless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No... No! Not yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we give up, that's truly the end of everything! Their smiles will never return!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So we just have to keep playing!
If we can do that, then—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But there's no one here to watch!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: People don't trust each other anymore. They're too afraid to leave their houses... Not even singing reaches them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even so...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even so, we can't just give up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That alone won't solve anything!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Without an audience... Without people who need our shows, theatre is pointless.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's all...pointless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No one...needs us?)

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Just stop already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Our shows, their smiles... They don't want them anymore?)

rows.Speaker: Voice
rows.Line: Your stories are pointless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What do I have left...?)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “No more...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Thank you, Harte...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “But this is the end. There's nothing left for me.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Blesse! Come on, Blesse!
This isn't like you!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “None of this matters.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line:
“No matter what I do, humanity will still hate.
Countries will still wage war.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “No matter how much we wrack our brains, no matter what we try to accomplish... Nothing ever changes.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Everything is...meaningless.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?
